transfer_audit.scientific_note: 296 matched keys comprise 253 floating-point weight/bias tensors (max_abs_diff=0.0) and 43 integer num_batches_tracked buffers.

scientific_limitation_statement: Transferring 296/308 backbone feature keys (253 weight/bias tensors) provides domain-specific feature extractor initialization. It does NOT prove detection efficacy on its own. The remaining 180 detector keys (heads, extra feature pyramid layers, and tail conv) must be trained on real bounding box annotations, and mAP must be measured empirically on held-out validation data.
